name: Red Hulk

abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.

signatureAbility:
Second Strike
General Ross prepares to cross the line in the sand, beginning the fight with 2 Heat Charge(s) ready and for each charge he gains [85.05 - 410.92] Physical Resistance.
Additionally, each Heat Charge provides him [8 - 20]% Incinerate Damage Resistance.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Whenever Red Hulk loses 10% of his Max Health, he gains 1 Heat Charge. For each Heat Charge he has, his attacks deal an additional 18% of the damage dealt as a burst of Physical Damage. Max Stacks: 10
Whenever Red Hulk is inflicted with a Poison or Incinerate Debuff, his altered state Removes it and has a 100% chance to convert it to a Heat Charge.

abilitySections.title: Blocking
content: Blocking has a 60% chance to convert Energy Attacks into Heat Charges. All Attacks from Mystic Champions are considered as Energy Attacks towards this ability.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Excess heat from this attack causes Red Hulk to gain 2 additional Heat Charge(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Expends 2 Heat Charge(s) to Regenerate [7,332.55] Health.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Red Hulk expends 3 Heat Charge(s) to Incinerate his opponent, dealing [41,848] Energy Damage over 8 seconds. This effect also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50% while it's active.
